meta.notes: DRAFT by Claude (s348) for Ben. EARTH = MODERN-DAY EARTH (Ben s348): a Nevada city of lights after dark. THE STRIP is the main north-south neon boulevard (14 m) with the town square, transport pad, fountain, big wheel + WELCOME sign at its crossing with FLAMINGO ROAD (palms). Huge modern casino resorts line it (Big Win tower, The Pyramid with its light beam, the chapel, the Showroom, the bar, Fox Cinema). N: FREMONT STREET downtown (roof-screen, buskers, the Boneyard of dead neon, The Loan Window, the police station, condo + apartments) → CITY HALL (Earth's "castle", Mayor Mr. Win) with its helipad + teleport pad. S: THE MOJAVE highway (diner, gas station, car wash, airport, date farm) → THE HIGHWAY → the GROOM ROAD east → THE SOUTH WIRE (fence, chained gate, the hole) → AREA 51 (the 2D Compound: hangars incl. HANGAR 18, tanker bay, radar, dry-lakebed runway, the ramp) → THE RING. W: Speedway Road to the figure-of-eight EIGHT MILE SPEEDWAY + FOX FIELD ballpark + the film lot. E: Starlite Road to THE STARLITE drive-in + THE BOARDWALK on Lake Mead (arcade, bumper cars, funhouse). NO SPACE DOCK on Earth (its own transport). Every building UNIQUE with a roof sign + eye-level door sign.

buildings.label: Big Win Casino

look.notes: MODERN-DAY EARTH AT NIGHT (Ben s348): black desert sky to a purple glow over the city, NEON + marquee bulbs everywhere (pink, gold, cyan, red), tall glass towers lit from inside, palm trees on Flamingo Road, headlights + taillights. The Mojave highway is dark with dusty desert + cacti; the compound is floodlit white. Earth is the only world always shown after dark (day: bleached desert light).

terrain.notes: EARTH = a flat desert valley city. The Strip, Fremont and every road stay flat. Mountains ring the valley (Spring Mountains west, red rock north-west), low desert hills south, Lake Mead east.
